estimators.ratio: mean(Masstree rounds) / mean(Expanse rounds) — or Expanse / Masstree for throughput — with a two-sample BCa 95% interval (scripts/bca_bootstrap.py)
estimators.columns: per-arm medians of the same rounds; the ratio column is not the quotient of the two median columns beside it
estimators.raw: every cell carries rounds_raw, the per-round samples verbatim
